card.description: A colossal obsidian engine, 3 meters tall and 2 meters wide, carved with Ethiopian basaltic ribs and Egyptian obelisk motifs. Its polished metal plating reflects flickering torchlight while intricate hieroglyphic circuitry runs along its surface. At its heart lies a translucent crystalline core that pulses with bio‑luminescent runes, swirling plasma, and an incomprehensible hum that hints at ancient, industrial mysticism.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Massive obsidian chamber with basaltic ribs, 3m tall, 2m wide, polished metal plating etched with ancient motifs.
**Face/Sensors:** Glowing glyph panels embedded in the surface, bio‑luminescent runes that pulse in sync with the core.
**Clothing/Armor:** Metal plating with etched hieroglyphs and Ethiopian stonework patterns, reinforced with carbon‑fiber ribs.
**Key Features:** Translucent crystalline core emitting swirling plasma, hieroglyphic circuitry, humming resonance, bio‑luminescent runes.
evolution: Phase 1 (Inactive): Engine dormant, core dark, no plasma, glyph panels dim.
Phase 2 (Activated): Core ignites, plasma flows, glyphs glow, humming resonance intensifies.
props: Item: Ancient Scroll – parchment with faded ink, leather binding, etched with cryptic symbols.
Item: Crystalline Core – translucent, pulsing crystal, 30cm diameter, emits soft blue light.
